statement.en: 2 scoped, topology-only hypotheses are published for this package; branch lengths do not represent time.
statement.zh: 本内容包发布了2 棵范围明确、仅表示拓扑的假说树；分支长度不表示时间。

limitations: These two trees reproduce the scoped root arrangements recovered by the cited morphology-matrix analyses; neither is the global navigation hierarchy or a claim of direct ancestry.
Character rescoring, outgroup choice and taxon sampling alter the root, so branch lengths and displayed temporal ranges must not be interpreted as support values or divergence times.
The trees stop at the three sampled major lineages and do not duplicate Avialae or crown-bird content owned by crocodylomorphs-birds.
